next_step_summary: PR #252 implements the second accepted post-audit correction by replacing the overloaded single AnswerState enum with a minimal orthogonal envelope: presence status, value status, evidence status, source status, and document lifecycle. This keeps handwriting dependency and source ambiguity separate from presence/absence and lets the same BLANK value be interpreted differently in TEMPLATE/DRAFT versus EXECUTED material when lifecycle is known. Existing smart inventories are not migrated in this PR, and no provider/runtime, statutory, ranking/UI, OCR, storage, network, dependency, permission, or workflow behavior is added. The next bounded corrective slice adds stable identity/cardinality for repeatable smart mechanisms so amounts, blanks, triggers, and other properties cannot drift between multiple security instruments or similar repeated entities.
